label: Road Ahead
description: One ride field: the elevation profile of the road in front of you, with no route loaded. It guesses the road ahead from the one you're on, reads the roads from the Karoo's own offline map, and fetches elevation over Wi-Fi. Tap the field to step between 2, 5 and 10 km.
releaseNotes: Fewer false dead ends. The Karoo's map has no service roads, so a slip lane can make a road look like it ends. Where the road picked at a junction stops within 35 m, the picture now goes back and takes another road from that junction, as a guess. On a circuit street it shows the whole lap.
